jobs.description: Test Automation Engineer- L2/L3 Networking This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. What you will do : Key Responsibilities - Design, develop, execute, and automate feature, platform, and system- level test plans based on product, platform, and solution requirements. Validate Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking features as part of broader system and solution workflows (e.g., switching, routing, resiliency, and high-availability scenarios). Perform platform-related testing, including: Hardware bring-up, Interface, and forwarding-path verification, Boot, upgrade, ISSU, reboot, and recovery scenarios, Redundancy, failover, and scale testing Develop and enhance test automation frameworks and reusable libraries using Python (PyTest preferred; Robot Framework is a plus). Execute end-to-end solution testing, covering multi-device topologies, control-plane/data-plane interactions, and traffic validation. Use networking test equipment (e.g., Spirent, Ixia) to generate and analyze traffic for functional, performance, and scale testing, and automate their usage where applicable. Analyze failures, debug complex issues spanning software, hardware, and network layers, and collaborate with engineering teams on root cause analysis. Document test coverage, results, defects, and risks; provide clear status updates to stakeholders. Support customer escalations by reproducing issues in lab environments and validating fixes. What you need to bring : - Automation-first mindset: Strong experience in Python-based test automation (PyTest), with the ability to build and extend automation frameworks. - Networking fundamentals: Good understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 concepts such as Ethernet, VLANs, basic switching, IP routing, and routing adjacencies. - System thinking: Ability to validate not just individual features, but complete platforms and solutions. - Debugging skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities across platform, protocol, and system interactions. - Team collaboration: Clear communicator who works effectively with development, architecture, and customer-facing teams. - Adaptable learner: Comfortable picking up new features, platforms, and technologies as products evolve. Technical Exposure (One or More Areas) - Layer 2 Layer 3 Features: Exposure to common networking protocols and mechanisms such as VLANs, LAG/LACP, spanning-tree variants, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, ISIS), and basic multicast concepts. - Platform System Validation: Hardware-software integration, control-plane and data-plane behavior, resiliency, scale, and performance testing. - High Availability Resiliency: Validation of redundancy, failover, convergence, and recovery scenarios across features and platforms. - Virtual Modern Networking: Familiarity with EVPN/VXLAN, VPLS, or virtualized networking environments is a plus. - Test Infrastructure Tools: Experience with traffic generators, lab automation, CI/CD-driven test execution, and result reporting. Experience and Qualifications - Education: Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field; Master s degree is a plus. - Experience: 2-5 years of experience in networking, platform, or system-level product validation / QA. - Certifications: Networking certifications (Juniper, Cisco, or equivalent) are beneficial but not mandatory. Required Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in Software Testing / QA Automation. Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks. Strong experience with API testing and automation using tools/frameworks such as Postman, REST Assured, Pytest, or equivalent. Strong understanding of QA methodologies, defect lifecycle, test design techniques, and software development lifecycle. Ability to independently own testing for a feature/product area and drive quality improvements. Good to Have Experience working on AI/ML, LLM, Voice AI, Conversational AI, or GenAI products. Experience testing LLM/AI agents, prompts, RAG systems, or model-driven workflows. Experience with performance, load, or reliability testing. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience with Docker and modern DevOps workflows. Experience building QA automation frameworks from scratch. Familiarity with observability, logging, and monitoring tools. Familiarity with test management/tracking tools (TestRail, Zephyr, Jira, or similar). What Were Looking For Youre a great fit if you: Have strong ownership and attention to detail. Think beyond happy-path testing and actively look for edge cases and failure scenarios. Have strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Can work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment. Have a quality-first mindset with the ability to balance speed and reliability. Have strong communication and collaboration skills. Success in This Role Youll be successful if you: Stand up a stable automation framework covering the most critical user journeys and APIs within your first few months. Meaningfully reduce manual regression effort and time-to-release through automation coverage. Catch critical defects, including AI/agent behaviour issues, before they reach production. Become the go-to owner for release quality and sign-off across one or more product areas. Build repeatable, trusted approaches for testing AI and conversational workflows, in partnership with the AI/ML team. Why Join RevRag AI Work on production-grade AI products used by real customers. Get exposure to Voice AI, LLMs, AI agents, and modern automation systems. Work closely with engineering, product, and AI teams. High ownership and direct impact on product quality. Opportunity to build and shape the QA automation function as the company scales. About RevRag AI RevRag AI is a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup building production-grade Voice AI and LLM-powered automation for customer-facing workflows. Our multilingual, in-app AI agents plug directly into BFSI journeys, improving digital onboarding, sales, and support while cutting operational cost by up to 70%. We are building next-generation diagnostic platforms that combine precision optics, electronics, robotics, computer vision, and intelligent software to enable faster, more accurate, and scalable blood sample analysis. Our work sits at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, scientific imaging, and physical instrumentation, with the goal of translating cutting-edge research into practical diagnostic solutions. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong Python backend development skills and practical experience in computer vision, image processing, or machine learning. You will play a key role in designing and developing the software platform powering our automated blood sample analysis systems. This includes building robust backend services, image-processing pipelines, integrating machine learning models, and connecting software with imaging hardware. The role involves taking existing research prototypes and building reliable, maintainable, and scalable production systems. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals who enjoys solving complex technical challenges across backend systems, image processing, and hardware integration. Key Responsibilities Backend & Software Development Design, develop, and maintain robust Python backend applications, services, and APIs. Build modular, scalable, and maintainable software architectures. Develop reliable data-processing pipelines for handling and analyzing large volumes of image data. Implement multithreading, asynchronous processing, task queues, and concurrency where required. Optimize application performance, resource utilization, and system reliability. Write clean, well-structured, testable, and documented code. Implement logging, error handling, automated testing, and debugging workflows. Take ownership of software components from design through development, integration, and deployment. Computer Vision & Image Processing Develop and integrate image-processing algorithms using Python, NumPy, OpenCV, and related libraries. Work on image detection, segmentation, classification, and analysis pipelines. Integrate machine learning and deep learning models into backend applications. Collaborate with research and ML teams to improve image-processing workflows and model performance. Develop image preprocessing, postprocessing, and analysis modules. Support model evaluation, inference optimization, and deployment across CPU, GPU, and edge environments. System Integration & Deployment Integrate backend software with microscopy cameras, imaging devices, and instrument-control systems. Work with hardware, optics, and electronics teams to develop reliable end-to-end workflows. Develop and maintain software interfaces for communication between imaging systems, processing pipelines, and application services. Debug and resolve issues across software, imaging, and hardware integration. Support deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of software on Linux-based systems. Architecture & Collaboration Contribute to software architecture, technical design, and engineering decisions. Collaborate with computer vision researchers, hardware engineers, and product teams. Participate in code reviews and promote software engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to improving development processes. Identify technical challenges and independently drive solutions from concept to implementation. Required Qualifications & Technical Skills 4-8 years of professional software development experience , preferably building Python-based applications or backend systems. Strong proficiency in Python , including object-oriented programming, type hints, modular architecture, debugging, and performance optimization. Experience developing backend services, APIs, and data-processing pipelines . Strong understanding of multithreading, multiprocessing, asynchronous programming, and concurrency concepts . Hands-on experience with NumPy, OpenCV, or similar image-processing libraries . Practical understanding of computer vision concepts , including image preprocessing, object detection, segmentation, or classification. Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent machine learning frameworks and integrating trained models into software applications. Experience building, testing, and deploying reliable software applications. Comfortable working in Linux environments , including debugging, configuration, and deployment. Familiarity with software integration involving cameras, devices, external SDKs, or hardware interfaces. Good understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and performance optimization. Experience with Git, automated testing, debugging, and collaborative software development. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. What We're Looking For We value strong software engineers who can build reliable systems and adapt to challenging technical problems. You may be a strong fit if you: Have built and maintained complex Python applications or backend platforms. Have experience working with image-processing pipelines, machine learning models, or data-intensive applications. Understand how to design scalable, maintainable, and reliable software systems. Can integrate different software components, APIs, and external hardware interfaces. Enjoy debugging complex issues and optimizing software performance. Are comfortable collaborating with researchers and engineers from different technical backgrounds. Take ownership of your work and are comfortable making technical decisions. Are interested in applying software engineering and AI to real-world scientific and diagnostic applications. Prior experience in biomedical imaging, microscopy, or healthcare is not mandatory. We welcome candidates from backend engineering, industrial automation, computer vision, robotics, scientific software, and other relevant technical backgrounds. Why Join Neuranics? Build meaningful technology: Contribute to diagnostic platforms designed to improve the speed, accuracy, and accessibility of blood testing. Own challenging engineering problems: Work across backend systems, image processing, AI integration, and hardware-connected software. Work with multidisciplinary teams: Collaborate with experts in optics, electronics, robotics, and artificial intelligence. Create real-world products: Transform research prototypes into reliable software that operates as part of physical diagnostic instruments. Make a direct impact: Join a deep-tech startup where your engineering contributions directly shape the product and technology. At Neuranics Lab, you'll help build the software foundation powering the next generation of automated blood diagnostics. 4-8 Yrs Processing, Opencv, Pytorch, Linux Platform, Python, Linux, Image processing, Tensorflow

Experience with Docker, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. Proficiency with version control systems such as Git. Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. Detail-oriented with the ability to manage priorities, work independently, and consistently deliver high-quality results. Who We are... We ve evolved from our consulting and development roots into a full-spectrum service provider, integrating advanced technologies like Generative AI (GenAI) to facilitate our clients seamless, transformative digital journeys. A passion unites our dynamic team of technology visionaries and business strategists for innovation and excellence. At SmarTek21, youll join a collaborative environment dedicated to shaping the digital landscape and driving impactful results for organizations worldwide. jobs.description: Job Summary Software Engineer - AI; Remote India; Department: Engineering; Remote Full-time. We're building the next generation of conversational voice and video AI for life sciences-intelligent with 100% regulatory compliance. Our AI medical experts help pharma teams engage doctors, support patients, and unlock insights faster than ever before. We've just raised our seed, signed our first customers, and are scaling fast. Everyone has the autonomy and the responsibility to drive projects, challenge decisions, and push things forward. We don't wait for permission. If you see a gap, you fill it. We use AI like a second brain. From writing code to writing docs, debugging flows to exploring new ideas, AI is part of our daily rhythm. Everyone here gets hands-on with the tools, learns how to prompt better, and treats AI as a teammate. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, AI systems, and infrastructure. You'll work on LLM-powered and voice-enabled applications, integrate external APIs, and own services from design through deployment and operation. You'll join a small, fast-moving team building real-world software for healthcare and pharma, where reliability, performance, and correctness are non-negotiable. We value engineers who take ownership, move quickly, and are comfortable operating across the stack. What You'll Do Build and maintain backend services that power AI- and LLM-driven products Design and implement APIs, data flows, and service integrations Productionize LLM-based workflows (prompting, retrieval, orchestration, evaluations) Deploy and operate services with a focus on low latency, high availability, and robustness Design and manage infrastructure (containerization, cloud services, CI/CD) Work on voice-enabled systems (STT/TTS, streaming APIs) as part of end-user experiences Monitor, debug, and optimize systems for performance, reliability, and cost Collaborate closely with founders and product stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable software Own features and services end-to-end, from initial design to production support What We're Looking For 2-5 years of experience in software engineering or backend-focused roles Strong proficiency in Python Experience designing and building APIs and backend systems Hands-on experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) Comfort with cloud infrastructure and DevOps fundamentals (Docker, AWS ECS/EKS/Lambda, observability, basic security) Interest in AI-powered systems, including voice and conversational interfaces Solid systems and architecture thinking, with a pragmatic approach to tradeoffs Ability to work with incomplete specs and make sound engineering decisions independently Job Details Location: Remote India Department: Engineering Work Arrangement: Remote Employment Type: Full-time Experience Level: Mid-senior-level Work Experience (years): 2 - 5 years Skills openai llms python 5-10 Yrs Lambda Expressions, Healthcare, Research, Docker, Architecture, Cloud, AWS, Debugging

Strong API engineering skills , including RESTful API design, authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, versioning, security, and performance optimization. Experience with relational databases, Entity Framework Core, efficient data access, caching, and application observability. 3. Frontend, Cloud & Modern Engineering Practices Strong hands-on experience with Angular or Next.js and TypeScript , including component architecture, state management, routing, and API integration. Solid understanding of frontend engineering concepts such as client/server rendering, caching strategies, session management, authentication, authorization, and performance optimization. Ability to implement application security features such as role-based access control, protected routes, token handling, and integrations such as reCAPTCHA. Strong appreciation for intuitive user experiences, usability, responsiveness, and maintainable frontend architecture. Practical understanding of AWS or Azure , including how cloud services are integrated and consumed within microservices-based applications. Good understanding of Agile and DevOps practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and how these enable faster, more reliable software delivery. 4. AI-Assisted Engineering & Team Productivity Practical experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar technologies. Demonstrate a clear understanding and practical approach to applying AI across everyday engineering activities, beyond basic code generation. Ability to effectively integrate AI into requirements analysis, technical design, development, code reviews, and documentation. Actively contribute to AI adoption and knowledge sharing within the engineering team while maintaining engineering standards and quality controls. 5. Communication, Collaboration & Ownership Excellent spoken and written English , with the ability to clearly explain technical approaches and communicate confidently with business and engineering stakeholders. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively, share knowledge, and support fellow engineers. A proactive can-do attitude , strong ownership, and accountability to independently drive assigned features and deliver results with minimal supervision. Experience & Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience , including strong hands-on .NET development. Proven experience developing and delivering enterprise applications using .NET with Angular or Next.js. Practical exposure to AWS or Azure in modern application development environments. Added advantages: Experience in airline, aviation, travel or reservation technology, and working with distributed engineering teams. What Matters Most We are not simply looking for an experienced developer. We are looking for a strong engineer who quickly understands business domains, has a deep understanding of how modern applications work end-to-end, and can independently implement secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Our key selection priorities are a can-do attitude, exceptional communication, deep technical understanding, independent problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to improve engineering productivity through AI. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer Lead
jobs.description: We are hiring a Lead Frontend Engineer with 10+ years of experience to own frontend architecture, performance, real-time communication, and UI systems at scale. This role is for an engineer who understands not only how to build UIs but also why certain styling, state, and library choices scale better over time. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Frontend Architecture / System Design: Design scalable, maintainable frontend architectures for complex web applications. Define application structure, module boundaries, and shared component strategies. Drive decisions around: Rendering models (SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR), Styling architecture, and State and data flow. Apply architectural patterns such as: Component-driven architecture, Feature/domain-based organization, and Micro-frontend patterns (when justified). Maintain architecture documentation, diagrams, and ADRs. Frontend Engineering (Hands-on): Build and maintain production-grade applications using Next.js (3+ years) and modern React. Write clean, maintainable TypeScript. Design and evolve reusable component libraries and design systems. Lead code reviews focusing on architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability styling / UI Architecture. Design and enforce scalable styling strategies using a mix of: CSS Modules, Styled-components / Emotion, Utility-first CSS (Tailwind or similar), Traditional CSS / SCSS where appropriate. Make informed trade-offs between: Runtime vs build-time styling, Global vs scoped styles, and Design system tokens vs local overrides. Build and maintain: Theming systems, Responsive and adaptive layouts, Cross-browser and cross-device compatibility. Ensure styling consistency and avoid CSS leakage and specificity issues. State Management: Architect complex state systems with clear separation of concerns: Server state vs. client state vs. UI state. Manage real-time and shared state across views and sessions. Prevent unnecessary re-renders and state coupling. Real-Time Communication: Build real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and WebRTC (where applicable). Design client-side subscription models, reconnection logic, and data consistency strategies. Coordinate real-time data flow with backend services and message brokers. Performance Engineering: Own frontend performance strategy across the stack: Code splitting and dynamic imports, Bundle size analysis and optimization, Rendering optimization and memoization, Virtualization for large lists. Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP). Use performance tooling (Lighthouse, Web Vitals, browser profilers). Security and Reliability: Implement frontend security best practices: XSS, CSRF, clickjacking mitigation, Secure auth flows (OAuth2 JWT, session-based), and Safe handling of tokens and secrets. Understand browser security, CORS, and content security policies (CSP). Ensure safe usage of third-party libraries and SDKs Libraries, Tooling Ecosystem. Expertise in build and tooling ecosystems: Webpack, Vite, Turbopack, Babel, ESLint, and Prettier. Testing libraries: Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright / Cypress for E2E. DevOps Delivery: Work with CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments. Experience with CDN, caching strategies, and edge deployments. Collaborate with DevOps on observability: Error tracking (Sentry or similar), Frontend monitoring and logging. Technical Leadership: Own frontend technical standards and best practices. Mentor frontend engineers and review architectural designs. Collaborate closely with backend engineers and solution architects. Act as a frontend representative in cross-team architecture discussions. Requirements: Strong experience evaluating and integrating frontend libraries, including UI libraries (MUI, Ant Design, Chakra, Radix, Headless UI), Form libraries (React Hook Form, Formik), Validation libraries (Zod, Yup), and Data visualization (D3 Recharts, Chart.js ). Hands-on experience with state libraries such as Redux / Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, Jotai, and React Query / TanStack Query. Must have: 10+ years of frontend/web engineering experience. 3+ years of production experience with Next.js . Expert knowledge of React, TypeScript, and browser fundamentals. 10-15 Yrs Nextjs, React.js, Typescript, Front end, Javascript

Work with business and client stakeholders to turn problems into practical technical solutions. Cloud and DevOps: At least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, containers, and secrets and environment management. Security and Responsible AI: Data protection, access control and AI-specific risks such as prompt injection. Nice-to-Have Agent Frameworks: Frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Open-Source Models: Fine-tuning and hosting open-source models. Classical ML and NLP: Techniques such as classification and entity extraction. Data Engineering: SQL, data modelling and pipeline orchestration. Microsoft Ecosystem: Azure AI services, Microsoft 365 integration and Power Platform. Speech and Vision: Experience with speech or vision models. Client Exposure: Consulting or client-facing experience. What This Role Is Not This is not a data science or machine learning research role.
